forecast.method: Frozen size/split-stratified calibration with admission-normalized real planning_worker_seconds; conditional bootstrap planning upper bound; serial strict-physics Wilson yield lower bound
warnings: The unchanged40 benchmark structures predate the user-authorized noble-target/geometry screens. Their throughput and strict-physics yield are planning proxies for the revised formal population, not guaranteed rates; actual formal batch times and acceptance update the remaining-budget gate.
forecast.calibration_design_note: Each split x site-count stratum contains its smallest and largest structure plus4 independent-hash selected others. The6-point mean deliberately includes size extremes. Bootstrap conditions on this design and is not an unbiased random-sample CI. Population weights use the frozen4000 real records, never1/10 per stratum.
forecast.real_timing_policy: Use positive planning_worker_seconds when present, otherwise positive raw relax_seconds, in every real timing calculation. Runner normalization is raw_relax_seconds*selected_max_workers/actual_admitted_workers, so dividing planning work by selected_max_workers preserves the wall cost of memory-limited1/2-worker admission. Synthetic benchmark throughput/bootstraps always use raw relax_seconds.

synthetic_runtime.method: 2000-replicate selected-worker per-candidate runtime bootstrap, multiplied by measured batch/ideal-work makespan factor

admission_adjustment.policy: Apply h2_admission.group_candidates separately to each split's requested point/upper prefix. Sum selected_workers/admission_workers per candidate and multiply by measured end-to-end benchmark seconds/item; no second division by workers. Use configured admission workers even for short groups.
admission_adjustment.limitation: Concurrency correction cannot estimate additional per-structure runtime of unusually large or dense graphs absent from the40-case benchmark. Formal observed batch-wall updates remain necessary. When a requested prefix exceeds its frozen reserve, this computes reserve exhaustion cost, not guaranteed target completion.

synthetic_runtime.dedup_note: Frozen H2 candidates have globally unique reduced compositions; species-respecting StructureMatcher cannot merge different compositions. Physics yield remains uncertain across unused template groups.

forecast.overall_interval_note: Sum of separate conditional97.5% runtime upper bounds and a Wilson95% yield lower bound, plus5% contingency and30min evaluation reserve; a conservative planning rule, not a calibrated joint95% CI.

details.real_upper_formula: 97.5percentile of2000 independent within-stratum replacement bootstraps, with frozen population counts and measured makespan correction
details.synthetic_formula: For each split, take prefix ceil(target/Wilson95yield_lower) capped by frozen reserve; sum(selected_workers/admission_workers) across that prefix; multiply effective units by selected-worker end-to-end seconds/item upper, without another worker division
